title: Count memory harms against primary evidence
body:
Outcome: memory evaluation counts harms next to hits: cases where an agent with memory erred although the original ADR, review or transcript held the answer; each memory entry keeps a path to its primary evidence (ADR 0002).
Source: operator RSS intake .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/rss-intake/2026-11-01.md item 2 (Memory Tax); related t-e2k99h7.
